windows.lead: Each plan's window quota (5-hour / daily / weekly / monthly) converted to per-model available tokens (in millions). The hard quota always lives in quota.windows on the Plans page; this table is the conversion, with per-row provenance and confidence, and never overrides the raw quota.
windows.method.heading: Conversion method
windows.method.derived: Derived from official coefficients: official credit formula / official token estimate / official legacy token mapping.
windows.method.community: Community measurement: from public community statistics.
windows.method.estimated: Estimated: converted using a community assumption (e.g. ~5,000–30,000 tokens per interactive request); order-of-magnitude only.
windows.note: The raw quota is the plan window's accounting value (credits / model_calls / tokens), not tokens. Converting to tokens needs extra assumptions, shown in each row's note. Community and estimated values are signals, not official hard quotas.
windows.coverage.heading: Coverage
windows.coverage.note: Covers every provider in the repo that has a convertible basis (13 of them). Still unknown: Kimi's current tiers and Xiaomi's other tiers lack community figures; CommandCode's Go / Max 10× / Max 20× / Team Pro do not publish per-model allowances (GOAT / Pro are converted from the official per-model credit tables); Meituan's Token Pack does not publish its pack sizes; BytePlus has only community request counts. Anthropic is never recorded by project policy. OpenRouter / Moonshot currently have no plans.
